purpose: Freeze strict-T0 H2 discovery-indicator adjudication together with prior-round label alignment so synonymous indicators are not miscounted as saturation novelty.
independence_order: First adjudicate inclusion, construct, proposed role, and T0 boundary from the supplied round worksheet under the strict-T0 component protocol. Only then consult the frozen prior-round reference for canonical-family label alignment.
alignment_rule: Reuse an existing canonical_family_label only when the theoretical object, explanatory role, and T0 boundary are substantively identical. Data-source, threshold, transformation, time-window, abbreviation, and lexical variants alone do not create a new family. Create a new label only for a genuinely non-redundant indicator family and explain why it cannot map to the frozen codebook.
decision_protection: Historical labels cannot change include or exclude decisions, proposed roles, exact evidence, or future-information exclusions. The reference contains no downstream dimensions, selected features, or model-performance outcomes.
novelty_rule: Round novelty is computed only after H2 label alignment against all finalized earlier rounds. A renamed synonym or parameter variant is not a new indicator family.
provenance_rule: For artifacts governed by this composite protocol, row-level independent_ai_prompt_sha256 and manifest prompt_sha256 must equal the SHA-256 of this JSON file. The manifest must record both reference hashes plus counts of included rows mapped to existing labels and included rows creating justified new labels.
